manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 233
text:
Page 001
001-1. THROUGHOUT THE AGES, BRIDES HAVE ALWAYS BEEN SO BEAUTIFUL.
001-2. QINGZI! WHAT ARE YOU DOING STANDING THERE?

Page 002
002-1. HAOZI!
002-2. WHY DO YOU LOOK SO LETHARGIC?
002-3. TO MAKE IT HERE TODAY,I HAD TO SWITCH SHIFTS WITH A COLLEAGUE, AND I RUSHED OVER HERE AFTER FINISHING THE SHIFT.
002-4. HEY,
002-5. WHERE IS YOUR PARTNER?
002-6. I DON'T HAVE A PARTNER!
002-7. KEEP ACTING!

Page 003
003-1. T/N: Around 113 USD with the current exchange rate.
003-2. I PUT EIGHT HUNDRED,IS THAT RIGHT?
003-3. THAT'S RIGHT, DON'T PUT TOO MUICH,IT'LL MAKE MELOOKLIKE A RICH GUY..
003-4. YOU'RE HERE.

Page 004
004-1. CONGRAT- ULATIONS!
004-2. I HOPE YOU TWO LIVE IN HAPPINESS AND HARMONY FOR A LIFETIME!
004-3. WHO AM IGIVING THIS TO?
004-4. LOOK AT WHAT YOURE SAYING..
004-5. TO HER!
004-6. THANK yOU.
004-7. TO BE ABLE TO GET A GUY LIKE WANG ZIJUN TO PUT ON HIS WEDDING CLOTHES SOEARLY.IS QUITE IMPRESSIVE.

Page 005
005-1. WOW...
005-2. THIS PROBABLY COST A LOT OF MONEY, RIGHT.
005-3. HE'SA RICH GUY, SO HE DEFINITELY SPENT A LOT OF MO- NEY.WHEN IT'S OUR TURN,IT WON'T BE AS LUXURIOUS AS THIS.
005-4. THAT'S GOOD THEN!

Page 006
006-1. WHYDO YOU SEEM SO RELIEVED?
006-2. I'M NOT!
006-3. SOMETHING'S WRONG WITH ME, WHY AM I TALKING ABOUT MY WEDDING?
006-4. I DON'T KNOW WHEN IT STARTED, IT STAKTED,
006-5. I ALREADY SEE XU QING AS MY FIANCE...
006-6. SO THIS IS WHAT A MODERN MAR- RIAGE IS LIKE.

Page 007
007-1. THEN THE TWO OF THEM WILL STARTLIVING TOGETHER..
007-2. THIS IS HOW THE GOOD-FOR-NOTHING DURING COLLEGE BEGINS THE NEXT PHASE OF HIS LIFE.
007-3. THE BRIDE TUEBRIDE SEEMS PRETTY IMPRESSIVE.
007-4. SHE'S MORE THAN JUST IMPRESSIVE.

Page 008
008-1. I'VE SEEN MANYOF WANG ZIJUN'S GIRLFRIENDS; THEY ALL SEEM SOPHISTICATED AND SOCIAL. THEYCANSEAMLESSLYNAVIGATE THROUGH FIVE OR SIX SOCIAL SCENES IN ADAY.I DON'TEVEN BOTHER REMEMBERING THEIR NAMES.
008-2. THE CURRENT BRIDE SEEMS TO BE AN ARTIST. I SAW HER ON THE SUBWAY THAT ONE TIME. ALTHOUGH HER ATTIRE WASN'T VERY ELA- BORATE, SHE LOOKED NEAT AND TIDY.
008-3. THEN, IN A LOW-KEY MANNER,SHE BROUGHT WANG ZIJUN TO A HOTEL. PERHAPS IT'S PRECISELY THISTYPEOFWOMAN WHO CAN REIN HIM IN.
008-4. THAT'S WHY UITTLE JIANG HE IS BETTER. WHEN SHE WANTS TO BEAT SOMEONE UP,SHETELLSYOUDIRECTLY AND DOESN'T DECEIVE ORTRICK YOU. SHE JUST CLENCHES HER FIST AND ISSUES A THREAT.
008-5. YOU'LL BE CARRIED INA SEDAN CHAIR IN THE FUTLRE, ALRIGHT?
008-6. REALLY?!

Page 009
009-1. AN EIGHT LIFT SEDAN CHAIR?
009-2. 宝家家家家家家家家家家
009-3. AN EIGHT LIFT SEDAN CHAIR, LIFT SEDANCHAIR, WITH TRUMPETS BLOW- ING WHILE CROSSING OVER FIRE BRAZIERS. SOUNDS MAJESTIC, DOESN'T IT?
009-4. A bright red wedding dress..

Page 010
010-1. The fengguan xiapei.
010-2. T/N: A type of traditional Chinese wedding set of attire categorized under Hanfu, which was worn by Han Chinese women in Ming and Qing dynasties.
010-3. Then you have to keep your word.
010-4. Of course.

Page 011
011-1. COMPARED TO THAT, EXCHANGING RINGS WITH MICROPHONES IN HAND SEEMS RATHER INSIGNIFICANT...
011-2. WHENWILL YOU TWO DO THAT,
011-3. GET MARRIED? --
011-4. NEXT YEAR.
011-5. SO FAST?!

Page 012
012-1. HOW CAN I NOT HURRY IT UP, THERE'SA GUY WHO'S ABOUT TO BECOME A DAD SOON.
012-2. WHAT DOES HIM BECOMING A DAD HAVE TO DO WITH YOU...MM!
012-3. WUUU..
012-4. Doesn't have a girlfriend yet. URGENT!
012-5. T/N: I'm sure our readers can relate!
